caption:
5 Balinese dishes to eat before you leave. Save this for your trip.

05 Sate lilit: wrapped round lemongrass, not threaded
04 Bebek betutu: duck slow-cooked in coconut-husk embers
03 Lawar: chopped together by the whole village
02 Babi guling: “the best pig I have ever had”, said Anthony Bourdain
01 Jimbaran seafood: grilled over coconut husks, eaten on the sand

Number 1 is a short drive from Yume by Nyara, our three private-pool villas above Bingin. Link in bio to book your stay in Bali.

slides.sub: Number 1 comes with your toes in the sand.

slides.label: 05 · Sate lilit
slides.body: Lilit means “to wrap around”. Spiced minced fish or pork is wound around a lemongrass stalk, then grilled.

slides.label: 04 · Bebek betutu
slides.body: Duck stuffed with turmeric, galangal and chilli, wrapped in leaves and cooked over smouldering coconut husk. Once kept for temple ceremonies.

slides.label: 03 · Lawar
slides.body: Minced meat, young jackfruit or beans, grated coconut and base genep spices, chopped by many hands before Galungan and Kuningan.

slides.label: 02 · Babi guling
slides.body: Filming in Bali in 2006, he called it “the best pig I have ever had”. It's rubbed with base genep and turned slowly over charcoal.

slides.label: 01 · Jimbaran Bay
slides.body: Fish and clams grilled over coconut husks, tables on the beach as the sun goes down. A short drive from Bingin, where the Bukit begins.

slides.credit: Villa Satu, Yume by Nyara, Bingin
slides.eyebrow: Now you know what to order
slides.body: Three private-pool villas on the clifftops of Bingin, a short drive from Jimbaran Bay. From USD 135 a night.
